facts.fact: Legal Notice 153 of 2024 substitutes rules 7 and 13 of the Births and Deaths Registration Rules so that the register of births and the register of deaths kept by a registrar in a registration area shall each be maintained in loose-leaf and electronic form; the notice gives no commencement date, so the date is its published date.
facts.system: register of births and register of deaths, in loose-leaf and electronic form

facts.fact: The amended rules prescribe that the registrar in a registration area keeps the register in loose-leaf and electronic form and completes each birth or death registration form in duplicate on paper, delivering it monthly to the sub-county registrar, who forwards the duplicate to the Principal Registrar; the rules say nothing of an online or national electronic register (a legal prescription, not a statement of deployment; dated to the notice's published date).
facts.system: register of births and register of deaths, in loose-leaf and electronic form

facts.fact: The rules are made by the Cabinet Secretary for Interior and National Administration under section 29 of the Births and Deaths Registration Act, and place the registers with registrars, sub-county registrars and the Principal Registrar (dated to the notice's published date).
facts.system: register of births and register of deaths, in loose-leaf and electronic form
